_notes.about: EXAMPLE config for pilot-server-public.py. Copy to public-config.json and fill in real values. NEVER put a real API key in any config file — the billed LLM key comes from environment variables only (ORYX_PUBLIC_LLM_BASE_URL / ORYX_PUBLIC_LLM_MODEL / ORYX_PUBLIC_LLM_API_KEY).
_notes.base_url: Used only to print invite links. Staging default is the localhost URL; at launch set the public app URL.
_notes.beta_allowlist: Empty = the operator may invite any email. Non-empty = the invite CLI refuses emails not on this list (closed beta).
_notes.cookie_secure: Set true only when serving over HTTPS at launch. False for localhost staging.
_notes.jobs_dir: Job storage, relative to the server file unless absolute. MUST differ from the local MVP's pilot-jobs.
_notes.monthly_spend_cap: Cap amount in the same currency units as the prices. 0 = unset. Public mode refuses to enable while this is unset/zero.
_notes.operator_email: The operator's email. Sees all jobs, can approve/export any. Required for serve.
_notes.port: Staging default 8933. The server binds 127.0.0.1 only, always.
_notes.price_per_1k_input_tokens: PLACEHOLDER — 0.0 means unpriced, not free. Replace with the real provider rate at launch; never assert a rate you have not verified. Spend is null while prices are unset.
_notes.price_per_1k_output_tokens: PLACEHOLDER — same as above, for output tokens.
_notes.public_enabled: Default false. Public mode ALSO requires a spend cap, per-token prices, and the billed backend env vars; otherwise the server runs in local-staging mode and says so.
_notes.quota_jobs_per_day: PROPOSAL (owner can change, not decided policy): 3 jobs/day/user. Counts every job created on a UTC calendar day, including failed ones.
_notes.reviewers: Emails allowed to view all jobs and approve/export (human review). Regular users see only their own jobs.
_notes.state_dir: Secret + login-token storage. Both files are created 0600.
